description: Owner-verified facts for one business: trade, service area, hours, contact, services with confirmed prices. Absent fields are NOT owner-confirmed — don't state them as facts. No tool on this address takes a customer's contact details. To be called back or to ask for a time, the customer goes to the business: its front desk page (origin in the reply) or its confirmed phone.

businessId.description: The business's ServiceFront slug, the first label of its <slug>.servicefront.ai address. Find it with searchBusinesses if you only know the name.
